# TIRED Labs Technique Research Report Library

A public library of Technique Research Reports (TRRs): research documenting how
attack techniques work, broken down into the distinct procedures an attacker can
use, each with a Detection Data Model describing the evidence it leaves.

**Browse the library at [library.threat-research.org].**

## What's here

Each report lives under `reports/`, one folder per report and platform. New to
TRRs? Start with the [TRR Guide], or read about the initiative's goals in the
[Project Overview].

## Contributing

Contributions of new research and corrections to existing reports are welcome.
See the [Contribution Guide] for how reports are structured, reviewed, and
published.

## Run your own library

This repository's `main` branch is the public library. The template it is built
from — tooling, workflows, and documentation, with no reports — lives on the
**`template` branch**, and anyone can deploy their own library from it, public
or private. See the [Deployment Guide].
